image_description: A black, wedge-shaped stage monitor loudspeaker system. It features a dual-driver configuration on the front face: two large woofers at the bottom and three smaller high-frequency drivers (tweeters/horns) arranged in a cluster at the top. The enclosure appears to be made of painted wood or MDF with a textured black finish. A white logo 'Triton' is visible on the upper right grille area. The speaker sits on small feet.
